dedupe_keys.name: zonage reglementaire de lʼassainissement des eaux pluviales

description: Zonage réglementaire de lʼassainissement des eaux pluviales is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie. Délimitation du zonage réglementaire des eaux pluviales sur les 11 communes de la Communauté de Communes Cœur Côte Fleurie avec 7 zones: A, B, C, D, E,F,G. Il sʼagit de zones où différentes mesures doivent être prises pour gérer le rejet des eaux pluviales. Coverage: Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie. The publisher named on the listing is Communauté de Communes Coeur Côte Fleurie. Its keywords include villerville, saint-pierre-azif, saint-arnoult, villers-sur-mer, trouville-sur-mer, tourgeville. The listing shows 4 download or service links in SHP, GEOJSON, KML, WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://opendatacommons.org/licenses/odbl/summary/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
